record.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:22 — create ignores the submitted alias_level, silently discarding the selected alias level

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the create method in app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb lines 22-31, the code only sets group.name and group.visible from params, but does not set group.alias_level. In contrast, the update method at line 38 does set 'group.alias_level = params[:alias_level].to_i if params[:alias_level].present?'. This means if a user submits an alias_level when creating a group, it will be silently ignored. The template (group.hbs) shows the alias level selector is present in the form, so users would expect it to be saved on create.
